topic: fixture — card proof, tried pillar with evidence
body:
I saved the same 5-row table twice. As CSV it took 100 bytes. As JSON it took 399.

Same rows, same numbers. JSON repeats every column name on every row, so the cost grows with each row you add.

I measured it with one command, wc -c, on both files. The files and the output are in the repo, so you can run it yourself.

If you paste tables into a chat model, the format you pick is part of the bill.

Today, take one table you paste into AI often and save it as CSV before you paste it.

Source: Decoding AI test log, 23 Sep 2026 — https://github.com/hbk9sj/decoding-ai/blob/main/render/fixtures/card-field/evidence/bytes.txt
